<infobox theme="Comic">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="writer"><label>Writer</label></data>	
        <data source="penciller"><label>Penciller</label></data>	
        <data source="inker"><label>Inker</label></data>	
        <data source="letterer"><label>Letterer</label></data>	
        <data source="colorist"><label>Colorist</label></data>
        <data source="cover artist"><label>Cover artist</label></data>
        <data source="editor"><label>Editor</label></data>			
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher</label></data>	
        <data source="release date"><label>Publication date</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{release date|}}}}}|future||{{{release date|}}}}}</format></data>	
        <data source="pages"><label>Pages</label></data>
        <data source="isbn"><label>[[Wikipedia:International Standard Book Number|ISBN]]</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{{isbn}}}|none||[[Special:Booksources/{{{isbn}}}|{{{isbn}}}]]}}</format></data>
        <data source="isbn2"><label>ISBN2</label><format>{{#if:{{{isbn2|}}}|[[Special:Booksources/{{{isbn2}}}|{{{isbn2}}}]]}}</format></data>	     
    </group>
        <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronological information</header>
        <data source="timeline"><label>Timeline</label></data>
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>	
        <data source="issue"><label>Issue number</label></data>
        <data source="preceded by"><label>Preceded by</label></data>
        <data source="followed by"><label>Followed by</label></data>			
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:GraphicNovel|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|title|writer|penciller|inker|letterer|colorist|cover artist|editor|publisher|release date|pages|isbn|timeline|series|issue|preceded by|followed by|optional=no_year_check,not_appearance,anthology,reprint,isbn2|ignore=name}}<!--
-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|no_year_check={{{no_year_check|}}}|template_name=GraphicNovel}}<!--
-->{{AppMediaCat|not_appearance={{{reprint|{{{anthology|{{{not_appearance|}}}}}}}}}}}<!--
-->{{#if:{{NAMESPACE}}||{{#if:{{{reprint|}}}|[[Category:Comic book reprints of earlier material]]|{{#if:{{{anthology|}}}|[[Category:Comic book story anthologies]]}}|}}}}<noinclude>[[category:Comic infoboxes]]

*{{Tl|ComicStory}}

Copy and paste the following code to use this template:
<pre>{{Top|real}}
{{GraphicNovel
|image=
|title=
|writer=
|penciller=
|inker=
|letterer=
|colorist=
|cover artist=
|editor=
|publisher=
|release date=
|pages=
|isbn=
|isbn2=
|timeline=
|series=
|issue=
|preceded by=
|followed by=
}}</pre></noinclude>
